description: Cloud -> Edge work envelope and result. The Edge pulls with its Device credential; Cloud never dials a restaurant LAN.

commandTypes.description: Does nothing on the Edge. Exists so the transport can be exercised end to end without performing restaurant work.
commandTypes.idempotency: Nothing happens, so nothing can happen twice.

commandTypes.description: Replace an existing order's lines, total and service-fee flag.
commandTypes.idempotency: Assignment, not adjustment: the payload is the order's new content, so a second delivery writes the same values. The audit diff is computed against what is stored, so a replay produces no events, and MoneyAudit already skips a service-fee entry when the flag did not move.

payload.updatedBy: string?, who the Manager identified itself as
payload.items: array of {itemName, quantity, unitPrice, itemKey?, comment?, menuItemId?, variantId?}

commandTypes.failure: order_not_found when no such order exists locally.

commandTypes.description: Remove an order from the POS and release the tables it held.
commandTypes.idempotency: The goal state is 'this order is gone'. An order already absent satisfies it, so a redelivery succeeds rather than reporting a missing order.

commandTypes.description: Set an order's status.
commandTypes.idempotency: Assignment. The same status written twice is the same status.

commandTypes.description: Create or update a takeaway order the Manager originated.
commandTypes.idempotency: Keyed on the Cloud-allocated posOrderId and written as an upsert, so a redelivery updates the one order. The kitchen check is sent only when the order did not already exist, so a replay does not reprint it.

payload.items: array of {itemName, quantity, unitPrice, comment?, menuItemId?, variantId?}

commandTypes.description: Create or update a walk-in dine-in order on one or more tables.
commandTypes.idempotency: Same as TAKEAWAY_ORDER_UPSERT: upsert on the Cloud-allocated posOrderId, kitchen check only on first arrival.

payload.items: array of {itemName, quantity, unitPrice, comment?, menuItemId?, variantId?}

commandTypes.description: Print an order's customer pre-bill on the POS receipt printer.
commandTypes.idempotency: Not naturally idempotent — paper is a side effect the world keeps. Safety comes from the local execution journal: a command already recorded as succeeded is acknowledged again without printing. A command interrupted mid-execution is NOT reprinted automatically, because the honest answer to 'did the paper come out' is unknown and a silent second check is worse than a reported failure.
commandTypes.failure: order_not_found; printer failures surface from the local print service.

commandTypes.description: Create a reservation the Manager or the public website originated.
commandTypes.idempotency: Cloud allocates reservationId, so the POS creates it only if that id is absent and returns the existing one otherwise. This is why the id moved to Cloud: a POS-generated id made a redelivery a second booking.

commandTypes.description: Set a reservation's status.
commandTypes.idempotency: Assignment.

commandTypes.description: Remove a reservation from the POS.
commandTypes.idempotency: The goal state is 'this reservation is gone'; already absent satisfies it.

commandTypes.description: Print a reservation's kitchen check on the POS kitchen printer.
commandTypes.idempotency: Journal-guarded, exactly as ORDER_CHECK_PRINT. An interrupted print is not repeated automatically.

commandTypes.description: Print a counted-menu draft on the POS receipt printer from the payload itself.
commandTypes.idempotency: Journal-guarded, exactly as ORDER_CHECK_PRINT. The draft lives in Cloud rather than POS Hive, which is why the whole thing travels in the payload.

payload.items: array of {itemName, quantity, unitPrice, total?, comment?, menuItemId?, variantId?}

commandTypes.description: Record an expense the Manager entered.
commandTypes.idempotency: Cloud allocates the expense id and the POS upserts on it, so a redelivery updates the one record instead of adding a second.

commandTypes.description: Add a staff user to the POS.
commandTypes.idempotency: The goal state is 'this username exists with this role and PIN'. Cloud has already refused a duplicate username before enqueueing, so a username that exists locally means the command has landed before; the handler reconciles the role and PIN and succeeds. Platform-managed commands carry staffId, platformAction and platformRevision. Persist the greatest successfully applied revision; ignore older delivery. Platform disable retains the local Staff row and prevents subsequent PIN login, including the last Manager. Requires the Phase 2 POS build before Platform access administration is enabled.

payload.staffId: string?, Cloud Staff identity for Platform-managed access
payload.platformRevision: int?, monotonic Platform Staff revision; older revisions must be ignored

commandTypes.description: Set a staff user's PIN.
commandTypes.idempotency: Assignment. The same PIN written twice is the same PIN.

commandTypes.description: Set a staff user's role.
commandTypes.idempotency: Assignment.

commandTypes.description: Rename a staff user.
commandTypes.idempotency: The goal state is 'newUsername exists and oldUsername does not'. A redelivery finds exactly that and succeeds without touching anything.

commandTypes.description: Remove a staff user from the POS.
commandTypes.idempotency: The goal state is 'this username is gone'; already absent satisfies it. Platform-managed commands carry staffId, platformAction and platformRevision. Persist the greatest successfully applied revision; ignore older delivery. Platform disable retains the local Staff row and prevents subsequent PIN login, including the last Manager. Requires the Phase 2 POS build before Platform access administration is enabled.

payload.staffId: string?, Cloud Staff identity for Platform-managed access
payload.platformRevision: int?, monotonic Platform Staff revision; older revisions must be ignored

commandTypes.description: Release a ghost table only when canonical identity and observed state match and no live Order or Reservation owns it. Edge only; Cloud updates through the authoritative snapshot.
commandTypes.idempotency: Immutable command identity, flushed repair intent, table/audit effects and retained receipt. Completed replay never clears later occupancy.

payload.mirrorUpdatedAt: string, server-owned original Cloud snapshot timestamp; ACK projection CAS only, excluded from local business request fingerprint

commandTypes.description: Apply a guarded Manager edit on the selected POS through one recoverable Order/audit intent. Edge only; Cloud mirrors only a validated POS result.
commandTypes.idempotency: Immutable request and exact POS baseline; durable business receipt survives transport pruning and returns the original result after later edits. Interrupted storage remains unresolved until recovery.

payload.request: {posOrderId, expectedFingerprint, items: frozen stable-line array, includeServiceFee, customServiceFeePercentage}
payload.baseline: version 1 POS-owned canonical order image string and SHA-256 fingerprint, orderUuid, effectiveServiceFeePercent
payload.mirrorUpdatedAt: original Cloud row revision for ACK CAS
payload.mirrorTables: original table identities/revisions for ACK CAS

commandTypes.failure: invalid_order_edit_request; stale_order; stale_date; closed_order; repair_required; service_fee_unavailable

commandTypes.description: Guarded Manager create/cancel/reservation request. Edge only; older POS registries must refuse before effects. Queue admission is not completion.
commandTypes.idempotency: Immutable Staff-scoped request and command identity. Order effects use retained POS05 receipts; interrupted standalone reservation work reports retained uncertainty without automatic reexecution.

payload.operationType: one of the existing non-print Order/Reservation operation spellings
payload.managerOperation: {requestId, kind, frozen body, allocated reference reply}

commandTypes.failure: unsupported_command_type; stale_date; order_id_conflict; manager_operation_outcome_unknown; explicit domain rejection. Storage recovery receives no false terminal ACK.

resultProjection: Optional POS-owned versioned result. ORDER_EDIT requires its frozen order image, fingerprint and effective fee percentage; other commands omit it.
